Metal and composites reinforced with continuous carbon fiber, engineered to work seamlessly with Markforged printers.

The Digital Forge is the world’s most reliable, intelligent, and easy-to-use additive manufacturing platform. Cloud-based, AI-powered, and always improving, it seamlessly connects software, 3D printers, and materials, empowering engineers and designers to quickly move from design to fully-functional industrial parts.

Everything we do is made possible by our people. We’re a driven team of engineers, problem solvers, and out-of-the-box thinkers. We’re constantly looking for ways to help manufacturers innovate and grow — and we’re always looking for hard-working, fun-loving individuals to help us on that mission.
Meet the leadership team driving the digital manufacturing revolution.

Located in Waltham, Massachusetts, our HQ features 120,000 sq. ft. of LEED Gold certified space to support up to 500 employees working collaboratively. Featuring plenty of conference rooms, open huddle areas and a rooftop deck, the building also includes multiple cafes, a gym on-site and a shopping plaza in walking distance with a supermarket and multiple restaurants.

Inside the Waltham HQ, we have a state-of-the-art research and engineering facility as well as a product showroom. Multiple labs and a print farm allow for collaboration across Engineering, Product and Customer Success as we work on innovations in hardware, software and materials.
Our manufacturing and operations teams are based in Billerica, Massachusetts, where we make all of the materials for our printers — from Onyx to continuous carbon fiber to metals.
We have remote teams and partners across the US, Canada, Europe, UK, Asia, and Australia. These teams work with customers on-the-ground to transform their operations.

Markforged is committed to engineering outreach. We strive to provide opportunities to learn about and practice engineering to populations which might not have access to such opportunities. Specifically, we hope to promote diversity and inclusion in future generations of engineers by supporting engineering-related programs in schools with a high concentration of underrepresented populations.

If your organization would like to apply for support from Markforged engineering, please contact outreach@markforged.com. We may be able to provide mentoring, 3D printing support, or 3D printed parts. For local school groups, we are sometimes able to offer tours of our R&D office in Waltham, MA.

Specializing in surveillance and payload delivery systems, Gamma Rotors—a leading drone manufacturer in India—shares how their investment in Markforged 3D printers, introduced through Phillips Additive, has accelerated their transition from rapid prototyping to full-scale rapid production.

By leveraging additive manufacturing for defense, warfighters can fabricate strong, lightweight parts on demand — anytime, anywhere. From shipboard 3D printing programs to airbase innovation labs, 3D printing technology empowers military personnel to print mission-critical parts in hours, rather than waiting weeks or months for traditional supply chains.
The U.S. Air Force utilizes the Digital Forge to print components for their combat training programs.
Learn how the Central Virginia VA Health Care System’s Assistive Technologies team seeks to improve the lives ﻿of military heroes through innovation.

In addition, as Markforged looks to meet demands for its products, it will also nearly double the size of its Billerica, Mass. filament manufacturing facility in 2022 by adding nearly 22,000 square feet, bringing the total footprint to 46,000 square feet. Markforged anticipates the completion of this expansion by the end of next year.
